Who We Are

At Purebred Kitties, we believe adopting a kitten is more than just finding a pet—it’s about welcoming a new family member. With our deep commitment to ethical breeding, transparency, and feline well-being, we connect families with healthy, sociable purebred kittens. Our passion for cats and years of expertise ensure you experience a smooth, joyful adoption process, filled with love and support. Let us help you find your perfect companion and create lasting memories.

Your Adoption Journey

1
Discover & Reserve

Explore our lovingly bred kittens—each with a unique personality—and click “Reserve Me” once you find the perfect match. If allergies are a concern, consider our hypoallergenic or hairless breeds. For added flexibility, check out our “Adopt Now, Pay Later” option.

2
Match Check & Confirm

After reserving, fill out a brief questionnaire about your home and lifestyle. Our breeder and adoption specialist will review it to ensure the kitten’s needs align with yours—no stress, no surprises. Once approved, we’ll guide you to the next step.

3
Plan Your Kitten’s Arrival

With your match confirmed, our team helps coordinate pickup or safe delivery. We’ll share tips on preparing a cozy space, so you can focus on the excitement of welcoming your new family member.

4
Vet Check & Clearance

Before releasing any kitten, it must reach 16 weeks of age, meet a suitable weight threshold, and fulfill strict health requirements—vaccinations, FIV/FeLV negative status, a vet exam, and a valid health certificate. Once a veterinarian gives the all-clear, we’ll confirm your pick-up or delivery date, marking the exciting moment you’ll finally meet your new feline friend.

5
Kitty Homecoming

It’s time to welcome your new kitten! With your pick-up or delivery finalized, you’ll review key documents and receive your kitten’s health records. We’d love to celebrate this special moment with you—so please share a photo of your new family member!

&
Join Family & Share Story

Become part of our Purebred Kitties Owners Club and connect with fellow cat lovers. Share photos, stories, and expert tips while inspiring others on their adoption journey. Your feedback and experiences make our community purr-fect!

Why you can trust us

Protection from Scams

Join us in the fight against kitten scams. We assure you with 100% certainty that our services will safeguard you from any form of scam. We prioritize transparency, effective communication, and fulfilling our commitments.

Only Reputable Breeders

We maintain a strict policy against kitten mills and take pride in linking you with ethical and trustworthy professional breeders who are dedicated to raising kittens with love and compassion in a home environment.

Comprehensive Health Guarantee

We perform extensive tests and veterinary examinations to ensure the optimal health and well-being of our kittens. Our commitment goes further with comprehensive health guarantee to make the transition as stress-free and enjoyable as possible for you and your family.

Join a Trusted Platform for Reputable Cat Breeders

At Purebred Kitties, we help ethical cat breeders streamline their breeding process. By joining us, you can focus on what you love—breeding—while we manage everything else, from marketing to placement. Our trusted platform connects you with a vast network of adopters who value quality and ethical breeding, ensuring your kittens find the best homes. Become part of a reputable breeders' network that prioritizes quality, ethical breeding practices, and kitten welfare. Experience the ease of connecting with prospective adopters and placing your kittens with families who share your values.
